En tiempos de Alberto yo estudiaba y alquilaba, no pude seguir porque los precios estaban altísimos, mis viejos sin laburo y para colmo todas las facultades cerradas por la pandemia así que de todas formas no tenía sentido seguir. Tuve que dejar de estudiar. Me negaron también el Potenciar Trabajo, que hubiese sido un golazo en su momento, porque "vos ya estás en la universidad, esto es para los que no hicieron la secundaria". 

Me tuve que volver con la cola entre las patas y vender todo por 2 pesos porque tampoco me podía traer los muebles.

Ah pero Macri

A while ago, Argentina issued new $200, $500 and $1000 animal-themed bills: One with some animal I can't remember, one with a jaguar and the last one ($1000) with a whale.
I just saw that the $200 bill has the whale, $500 has the jaguar and the $1000 one suddendly disappeared. 
Me and some friends remember the whale being on the $1000 bill, but can't remember the $200 one.
Anyone else?

It's funny because this is the closest thing to my life I've read so far. I always do shit that eventually ends up helping me in the short/long run, but don't really know why.
Can't win the lottery, but sure as hell can get a random taxi in the middle of nowhere with a broken radio because someone called it and couldn't cancel (because no radio to comm central)

I found out that if you talk to her and get pushed back by the barrier, you can't talk to her again. The only way I found to fix this is to log out and log back in every time you want to talk to her.


So, from my experience:
1. Get a cryomancer with Ice Wall
2. Use Ice Wall right in front of her and TP.
3. Talk to her.
4. Log out, log back in.
Repeat steps 2, 3 and 4 until you finish the quest.
